summary: Control and burst on a fragile frame: Frost Nova roots and Frostbolt slows enable kiting, with Fireball and Frostbolt burst. Note the iconic Polymorph and Blink unlock at level 20, one above the bracket, so a 19 mage relies on Frost Nova for control. Skill- and comp-dependent.
factionNotes: Mages play both factions - Gnome (Alliance) Escape Artist frees them from roots and snares, a strong kiting racial, while Troll (Horde) Berserking adds casting haste. Verify current racial and spell-rank specifics against the Wowhead Mage guide at authoring.
